title: Partner’s house · LK1891
assumptions: Traced from the official LK1891 drawings; the publisher’s linked image filenames use 1480. No rooms have been added or mirrored.
Room areas are the publisher’s values, not measured from this simplified mesh. The floor subtotals differ by 0.01 m² from the published usable total due to rounding.
Scale: 1,028 pixels = 12.50 m, cross-checked against 1,110 pixels = 13.50 m. Upper drawing registered on the stair core.
Floor-to-floor height 3.30 m is inferred. Clear room height 2.70 m and overall height 7.55 m are published; parapet and roof build-up are approximate.
Doors, window sill heights, railings and stair risers are conceptual details inferred from the drawings and exterior images. Furniture is omitted in this first architectural pass.
On site: rotated 180°, entrance toward shared parking. Carport stays in the original layout; vehicle access is not validated.
The full visible envelope including terraces is approximately 14 × 15 m. Placement uses the earlier sketch and image-derived plot; it is not a surveyed or approved setback study.
limitations: Image-derived conceptual geometry, not construction or code approval.
Door is shown fixed open; windows and balcony rails remain solid.
Furniture has not been added to this house.
